no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Use IndexedDB via packages/web/app/lib/user-preferences-db.ts or a domain-specific *-db.ts module instead. localStorage is only allowed in one-time migration code, and must be marked with // oxlint-disable-next-line no-restricted-globals.

no-restricted-globals.name: sessionStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Use IndexedDB via packages/web/app/lib/user-preferences-db.ts or a domain-specific *-db.ts module instead.

paths.name: @/app/lib/db/db
paths.message: Use Drizzle's getDb() or dbz from @/app/lib/db/db instead of the raw Neon sql client. New code must go through the Drizzle query builder.

no-restricted-properties.message: Hermes does not implement Intl.RelativeTimeFormat — crashes mobile release builds. Use dayjs relativeTime via @boardsesh/profile-stats.
Hermes does not implement Intl.ListFormat — crashes mobile release builds. Join the parts manually or via i18n.

Linking.openSettings() does not exist in the Expo web runtime (react-native-web's Linking has no such method) — it throws on app.boardsesh.com. Use openAppSettings() from src/lib/open-app-settings, which Platform-gates and never throws.

patterns.message: @expo/ui/swift-ui resolves native SwiftUI views at module load — importing it on Android crashes at runtime ("Unable to get view config"). Import it only from a *.ios.tsx / *.ios.ts file and platform-split the component (see SwitchRow / FilterChipRow and docs/expo-ui-components.md).

@expo/ui/jetpack-compose resolves native Compose views at module load — importing it on iOS crashes at runtime ("Unable to get view config"). Import it only from a *.android.tsx / *.android.ts file and platform-split the component (see SwitchRow / FilterChipRow and docs/expo-ui-components.md).

paths.name: @boardsesh/offline-sync
paths.message: Import these from src/offline/offline-sync-adapter instead — the package leaves the connectivity probe, AppState/NetInfo triggers, and Sentry telemetry injected, and only the adapter binds them.

paths.name: @expo/ui
paths.message: Use ThemedHost (src/components/ThemedHost) instead. A bare `Host` themes its native subtree from the DEVICE colour scheme — on Android both the JS palette (react-native useColorScheme) and the Compose theme (isSystemInDarkTheme) ignore the in-app Light/Dark override, so a dark app on a light phone renders near-black Compose text on the dark surface.

paths.name: react-native
paths.message: Use the Text primitive (src/components/Text) instead — it resolves the per-variant type scale and defaults the colour to the adaptive theme.systemColors.label. RN's own Text defaults to non-adaptive BLACK and breaks in dark mode. See docs/ai-design-guidelines.md.

paths.name: react-native
paths.message: Use useAppColorScheme() from src/providers/theme-provider. RN's useColorScheme follows the OS trait collection and on Android does NOT track Appearance.setColorScheme, so it reads 'light' for a user running the app's own Dark theme on a light-mode phone (issue #3885).

patterns.message: @expo/ui/jetpack-compose is Android-only — it must not be imported from a *.ios file. Put Compose code in the matching *.android.tsx file.
